_comment: spike_rv is the Flow A / RISC-V target this repo's spike reproduction
runs on: one RVV hart (CPU_P) and one scalar hart (CPU_E). The
machines/profile_hw/profile block is field-for-field the one in
scripts/repro_mlp_dronet_yolo_spike.sh builds and runs end to end, so
anything generated against this config resolves the same profile CSVs.

spike_rv.description: spike RISC-V through ModelBlaster: RVV hart (CPU_P) + scalar hart (CPU_E), one lane each. Profiles are the results.csv files modelblaster writes under gen/profile/{RVV,scalar}/spike.
